subject: Business Models
title: Marketplace Pricing Strategies
description: A 60-second lesson on Marketplace Pricing Strategies.

hook.text: Uber sets the price. Etsy lets sellers set theirs. eBay lets buyers bid. Three pricing models, one goal.

buildup.text: Who controls the price—platform, seller, or buyer—defines the marketplace's power dynamics.

discovery.text: Platform-set pricing creates consistency. Seller-set pricing creates competition. Auctions discover true value.

twist.text: Uber's centralized pricing enraged drivers who couldn't negotiate. But consistent fares built rider trust.

climax.text: Pricing control is the most consequential design decision a marketplace makes. It shapes everything else.

punchline.text: Who sets the price holds the power. That one choice shapes it all.

quiz.question: What's the advantage of platform-controlled pricing?
